issues.detail: The Greek 'δε παραγενωμαι' is a negative construction (not coming), but the Vietnamese 'Khi tôi đến' (When I come) omits the negation, changing the meaning from 'when I do not come' to 'when I come'.
The Greek 'δοκιμασητε' is a passive construction (you were tested/tried), whereas the Vietnamese 'anh em đã thử nghiệm' implies the brothers themselves did the testing of others.
